_comment: Per-unit hall-sensor calibration offsets, in stepper steps: the one value
on a unit that is not reconstructible. An erase of a unit's EEPROM leaves
its address to the DIP switches and restarts every counter at zero, but an
offset only exists because somebody calibrated that drum by hand.
A board is named by its id (GET /api/v2/wall); every board is reached
through the master. restore-unit-offsets.sh compares, --apply writes the
captured values back, --capture overwrites this file from the wall.
